subject: NordicPay: DPIA support, audit access & cross-border clarity
messages:
From: Emma Lund <emma.lund@nordicpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: NordicPay Privacy Team <privacy@nordicpay.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 14:12:00 +0200
Subject: DPIA support & audit scope for NordicPay onboarding

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on — NordicPay is moving forward with a pilot integration of Redwood Dedicated for a payments metadata workload and our GDPR reviewers have a couple of asks before procurement can sign off. High level: we need (a) confirmation of audit rights and sample evidence for Art. 28/30 records, (b) clarity about subprocessor locations (APAC transfers) and any safeguards you apply, and (c) a rough timeline for turning around a completed DPIA questionnaire.

Concretely:
- Please share an example extract (Art. 30 style) showing processing categories, subprocessors, and retention buckets.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood’s Private deployment option keeps backups within EEA for our contract? If not, what contractual/technical measures do you offer for cross-border transfers?
- We have a short DPIA template attached for your legal/compliance team to complete; target is to have that back in 10 business days if possible.

We may need a short conference call with your privacy/legal folks this week — ping me availability.

Thanks,
Emma Lund
Data Protection Officer
NordicPay
[attachment: DPIA-questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx, 38KB)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Lund <emma.lund@nordicpay.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPIA support & audit scope for NordicPay onboarding

Emma — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Jonas (Privacy Ops) and Kimberly (Legal) to own the DPIA and Art. 28/30 samples. Quick answers up front:

- Private deployment: customers can choose a VPC/on-prem kit; for NordicPay we can scope a Private deployment that keeps backups and snapshots in the EEA region. If you prefer Hosted, we provide SCCs and a transfer risk assessment and offer additional contractual safeguards (e.g., data localization addendum).
- Subprocessors: we maintain an up-to-date inventory and a subprocessor change notification cadence (30 days). We'll provide a populated mapping for your workload showing data flows to any APAC transient services.
- Timeline: we can complete the DPIA questionnaire within 7 business days once legal has the completed template and one follow-up call. If you need faster, we can aim for 3 business days for an initial pass.

Action items:
1) Jonas will send an Art. 30 example extract and the current subprocessor mapping (attachment) by EOD Monday.
2) Kimberly will review the DPIA template and identify any contract clarifications (SCC/transfer addendum) by Wed.
3) Marissa (me) will schedule a 30-minute call — propose Mon/Tue availability attached.

If that works I’ll mark this as a high-priority onboarding task and tag it in our onboarding tracker.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
[attachment: proposed-call-slots.ics (ics, 1KB)]
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Emma Lund <emma.lund@nordicpay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Jul 2028 09:28:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: DPIA support & audit scope for NordicPay onboarding

Hi Emma / Marissa,

Attached: a short Art. 30 sample extract CSV showing processing categories and a redacted subprocessor mapping PDF. Notes below on the key points you asked about.

1) Art. 30 sample: the attached extract is redacted for confidentiality but matches the structure we provide for customers: processing activity, purpose, categories of data subjects, recipients (subprocessors), retention period, transfer mechanisms.

2) Subprocessor geography & safeguards: for the specific pilot workload you described (tokenized payments metadata), primary compute and storage will be in eu-central-1. Transient replication to APAC only occurs when Dedicated burst capacity is provisioned there — we do not replicate backups to APAC unless explicitly contractually permitted. For Hosted customers we default to SCCs + encryption at rest and in transit; for cross-border residual risk we offer a transfer addendum (contractual) and can enable customer-managed KMS for extra control.

3) Audit evidence & access: for remote audits we provide:
- Art. 30 registers and subprocessor docs (PDF)
- Sample configuration exports (Art. 28/30 extract)
- Operational logs for the target timeframe (redacted operational logs; full logs available under NDA and on-site review)
- KMS wrap and crypto attestation summary

Expectations and timing: we can deliver the unredacted subprocessor mapping and Art. 30 export under our standard NDAs within 7 business days; operational logs require a formal evidence request ticket and typically a 10–15 business day window. If you need an accelerated path for a procurement cutoff, we can prioritize the mapping and Art. 30 extract in 3 business days.

Attachments:
- subprocessor-mapping.pdf (PDF, 112KB)
- art30-sample-extract.csv (CSV, 22KB)

Let me know a good time for the call and we’ll run through the DPIA template line by line.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Privacy Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Emma Lund <emma.lund@nordicpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: NordicPay Procurement <procurement@nordicpay.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jul 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPIA support & audit scope for NordicPay onboarding

Thanks Marissa and Jonas — that level of detail helps a lot. Two quick confirms:

1) Please send the unredacted mapping and Art. 30 extract under NDA to privacy@nordicpay.com; we’ll sign the standard template by EOD.
2) Procurement asks whether Redwood can commit to backups/restores staying within EEA for the pilot (they prefer this as a conditional clause in the DPA); if you can confirm in writing I’ll ask legal/procurement to proceed with a draft PO.

We can do a call Wed 09:00–09:30 CET — will that work for your team? If Jonas/Kimberly can cover the Art. 30 and contract Qs that should be sufficient.

Appreciate the responsiveness — looking forward to the attachments and NDA routing.

Kind regards,
Emma Lund
Data Protection Officer
NordicPay
